$comment: Agent notes for Rich messages. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite.

sendRichMessage.purpose: Send one complete structured message (headings, lists, tables, media blocks) as a Rich message.
use_when: reports, AI answers, docs and tables longer than a short reply
the final message after streaming drafts with sendRichMessageDraft
avoid_when: short notifications, prompts and replies: sendMessage is enough
the message is fundamentally one photo, an album or a file: use sendPhoto, sendMediaGroup or sendDocument

pitfalls.text: rich_message takes exactly one of html, markdown or blocks.
pitfalls.cite: InputRichMessage: Exactly one of the fields html, markdown, or blocks must be used.

pitfalls.text: A media block needs the bot's right to send that media in the chat.
pitfalls.cite: sendRichMessage: the bot must have the right to send the media to the chat

pitfalls.text: chat_id may be omitted only for an ephemeral reply to a callback query.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: required unless the message is sent as an ephemeral reply to a callback query

sendRichMessage.rights: send messages; media blocks also need the matching media right

sendRichMessageDraft.purpose: Stream a partial Rich message into a private chat while the answer is still being generated.
use_when: AI or long-running answers that should appear progressively
avoid_when: groups and channels: drafts target private chats only

pitfalls.text: A draft is a temporary preview; send the final text with sendRichMessage or it is lost.
pitfalls.cite: the streamed draft is ephemeral and acts as a temporary 30-second preview - once the output is finalized, you must call sendRichMessage

pitfalls.text: draft_id must be non-zero; reuse it to animate updates, a new id replaces the draft.
pitfalls.cite: draft_id: must be non-zero. Changes to drafts with the same identifier are animated.

pitfalls.text: No direct upload or upload by URL inside a draft.
pitfalls.cite: rich_message: Direct upload of new files and explicit upload of files by a URL isn't supported.

InputRichMessage.purpose: The Rich message a bot sends: content as html, markdown or blocks, plus media those reference.

pitfalls.text: Exactly one of html, markdown or blocks; media is only for tg:// links in html or markdown.
pitfalls.cite: InputRichMessage: Exactly one of the fields html, markdown, or blocks must be used.

InputRichBlock.purpose: One typed block of InputRichMessage.blocks: the JSON form of a Rich HTML block tag.
use_when: content comes from data or a CMS: no markup to generate or escape
avoid_when: hand-written or short text: html or markdown is shorter

pitfalls.text: Since 10.5 an expandable quote holds blocks; text is not a field.
pitfalls.cite: InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation: blocks (Array of InputRichBlock), Content of the block

pitfalls.text: A media block ignores the InputMedia caption; use the block's RichBlockCaption.
pitfalls.cite: InputRichBlockPhoto: photo: The photo. Caption is ignored.

pitfalls.text: Table cells need align and valign; list items hold blocks.

pitfalls.cite: InputRichBlockThinking: The block may be used only in sendRichMessageDraft

RichBlock.purpose: One block of a received RichMessage (Message.rich_message); members mirror InputRichBlock*.

pitfalls.text: Received media are objects (photo: PhotoSize array); rebuild InputMedia* from the file_id to resend.
pitfalls.cite: RichBlockPhoto: photo: Array of PhotoSize, Available sizes of the photo

pitfalls.text: A received list item has a required label, the shown marker.
pitfalls.cite: RichBlockListItem: label (String, required), Label of the item

RichText.purpose: Inline rich text, sent and received: a string, an array of RichText, or a typed object.

pitfalls.text: There is no InputRichText: one union serves both directions.
pitfalls.cite: RichText: it can be either a String for plain text, an Array of RichText, or any of the following types

pitfalls.text: A button label may hold only plain text, custom emoji and date-time.
pitfalls.cite: RichMessageButton: text: May contain only plain text, RichTextCustomEmoji and RichTextDateTime entities.

pitfalls.text: Nested formatting counts toward the 16 nesting levels.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#rich-message-formatting-options (Rich Message Limits: 16 levels of nested formatting and blocks)

RichMessageButton.purpose: A button inside a rich message: in a buttons block row or inline as RichTextButton.

pitfalls.text: Exactly one action field besides text and style.
pitfalls.cite: RichMessageButton: Exactly one of the fields other than text and style must be used

pitfalls.text: style link only on callback buttons; callback_data is 1-64 bytes.
pitfalls.cite: style: The style “link” is allowed only for callback buttons. callback_data: 1-64 bytes

pitfalls.text: web_app only in private chats; login_url not in ephemeral messages.
pitfalls.cite: web_app: Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. login_url: Not supported for ephemeral messages.
